summary.intent: Scope Phase 51 ('Crypto-Signature Secret-Leak Hardening') down to only IPNS crypto-signature work (S1/S2/S3), removing the Faro transport wiring and logger redact() interceptor (todo #15) which were bundled in the original phase definition.
summary.outcome: Todo #15 dropped entirely from Phase 51; CONTEXT.md, ROADMAP.md, REQUIREMENTS.md, and DISCUSSION-LOG.md all updated and committed to reflect the narrowed scope.

repo: Phase 51 originally bundled two unrelated concerns: IPNS crypto-signature hardening and Faro/monitoring secret-leak prevention — they were split after discussion.

The logger redact() interceptor (HARD-02 in REQUIREMENTS.md) only has security value with a remote transport; without Faro it only protects the browser console, making it effectively a no-op for the threat model.
Acceptance criteria for the redact() interceptor explicitly require Faro to verify, so dropping Faro forces dropping the interceptor too.
The project uses a .planning/ directory with per-phase CONTEXT.md, ROADMAP.md, REQUIREMENTS.md, and DISCUSSION-LOG.md files as the planning artifact structure.

code.finding: Phase 51 one-liner entry that was updated to reflect narrowed scope
HARD-02 requirement (logger redact interceptor) removed as part of scope reduction

workflow: When a todo bundles an infrastructure prerequisite (Faro transport) with a dependent feature (redact interceptor), removing the prerequisite forces removing the dependent too — check acceptance criteria before deciding.
The session used AskUserQuestion to gate the scope decision before making any edits, keeping the planning files in sync with the agreed scope.

friction: Todo #15 silently bundled two concerns (monitoring transport + secret-leak interceptor) under a single item, requiring a discussion to untangle before planning files could be updated correctly.
open_items: Faro transport wiring (registerFaroTransport) deferred to a future phase — end-user monitoring not yet planned.
Logger redact() interceptor (HARD-02) deferred until Faro transport exists, since its acceptance criteria require Faro to verify and its security value is marginal without a remote transport.
